provenance.notes: Maps only fields genuinely determinable from a Savings Plans inventory. The join key is savingsPlanArn, the fully qualified identifier (arn:aws:savingsplans::<account>:savingsplan/<uuid>) that FOCUS recommends for CommitmentDiscountId/ContractCommitmentId; version 1 used the bare savingsPlanId and could never join a Contract Commitment keyed by ARN. paymentOption uses the same vocabulary as FOCUS ContractCommitmentPaymentModel. termDurationInSeconds maps the two offered terms (1 and 3 years) to the FOCUS duration format; any other value is left for the client. The three constants are invariant facts of the Savings Plans product: it is a discount commitment (BenefitCategory=Discount), applies continuously to eligible usage (Model=Continuous), and commits to an hourly spend rate (FulfillmentInterval=Hourly). ContractCommitmentLastUpdated and ContractCommitmentApplicability are NOT emitted (not present in the export) — the client supplies them and coverage reporting shows the residual gap. OfferCategory is left out because a Savings Plan may be public or under a negotiated agreement, which the export does not distinguish.
